extraction.notes: Read in full (nine pages; page 9 is references). Whole document concerns foreign workers in the Western Balkans, so items are Chapter 2 where they concern access to the labour market and rights of foreign workers. Under the rule for regional documents, extracted: claims naming North Macedonia and regional claims in the same section of findings. The Roadmap (pages 7-8) does not name North Macedonia. Its six items (0024 to 0029) were removed at the second pass under the rule for regional documents; their IDs stay unused and their full text is in review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/MKD-IO-2026-001.csv for the analyst at G5. The highest ID ever used is 0029, so any new item must start at 0030. LEFT OUT as not naming North Macedonia: the recruitment findings on page 5 (unlicensed brokers, debt, monitoring of licensed agencies), which name other countries; claims about emigration from the region (page 2, out under the Chapter 2 boundary); country examples for Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, Montenegro and Serbia. Table 1 (page 4) rows that restate the running text are not extracted again, apart from row 5, which adds a claim (EU alignment, database access). This is a policy summary; the full PSIMM report is not in the source set. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2).
